query: INSERT INTO editorial.review_assignments(id,case_id,review_snapshot_id,reviewer_id, status,assigned_by,assigned_at,due_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,'ASSIGNED',$5,clock_timestamp(),$6) ON CONFLICT(case_id,review_snapshot_id,reviewer_id) DO UPDATE SET status='ASSIGNED',assigned_by=EXCLUDED.assigned_by,assigned_at=clock_timestamp(), due_at=EXCLUDED.due_at,completed_at=NULL,version=editorial.review_assignments.version+1
